2.3.rationale: The candidate sentences include references to “monitoring,” “reporting,” and “recording,” but these are not explicitly framed as establishing or assigning responsibility for a system/entity to collect or manage data on violence against women or VAW cases. 2.4.rationale: The policy explicitly requires the Regional Government to conduct gender mainstreaming and specifies institutional/coordination actions (establishing implementation, coordinating/facilitating/mediating, and developing gender mainstreaming mechanisms in institutions).
